title: dataset.available
description: Published by an upstream producer when a vendor CSV dataset has been landed in ADLS and is ready for ingestion processing.

dataset_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the dataset. Used as the idempotency key for Bronze layer partition overwrite.

storage_path.description: Full ADLS Gen2 URI (abfss:// scheme) pointing to the vendor CSV file.

vendor_id.description: Identifies the vendor. Together with schema_version, resolves the VendorSchemaMapping in the schema registry.

schema_version.description: Version of the vendor's CSV schema layout. Used to look up column mappings and unit conversions.

correlation_id.description: W3C traceparent value propagated end-to-end for distributed trace correlation.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this event was published.
